description: Development query set for the Prompt Interpreter (report §5.9.1). Every concept of the taxonomy appears at least twice. `expected` is the target concept id, or null for an out-of-scope query. Use it to tune prompts; the held-out set used for the final measurements must be written separately and never used for tuning.
